summary: The candidate is correct. The heaviest retained label captures at least a 2^{-n} fraction of each physical target's I-triangle mass; scaling the supplied single-label metronoid realization to mass 4 times that label mass is valid; the metronoid depth lemma makes the resulting selector weights admissible; and the exact definition of R_sel yields (1). Since D is a separate nonnegative summand of the canonical capacity and D is at least R_sel, (2) follows. The support and low-rank exclusions then follow with the stated strict inequalities, including all finite, zero-rank, and boundary cases.
